```bash
# Prefer ./tools/cargo.sh over bare cargo: it resolves the pinned 1.99.1 toolchain. The refusal of Cargo config/env that would substitute the compiler lives in the --abbey-qualify-toolchain probe below, not in the ordinary invocations. ./check.sh resolves the same toolchain via tools/toolchain-env.sh.
./tools/cargo.sh build --release --locked   # build the default members (abbey + desktop client + desktop codegen) in the safe public edition
./tools/cargo.sh --abbey-qualify-toolchain   # toolchain probe only: policy check + rustc 1.99.1 assertion
python3 tools/toolchain_policy.py  # reject Cargo config/env that would substitute the qualified compiler
./tools/cargo.sh check --locked --quiet    # the gate's first compile step: check every default member
./tools/cargo.sh build --locked -p abbey --features wdbx    # + in-process WDBX memory backend (off by default)
./tools/cargo.sh build --locked -p abbey -p abbey-desktop --features personal-edition  # separately identified personal edition (src/edition.rs)
./install.sh                       # Unix: install abbey + the authenticated abbeyd daemon + shell completions (Windows: install.ps1 installs abbey + PowerShell completions, but not the daemon — the daemon is Unix-socket-only)
./check.sh                         # production gate — takes a per-checkout lock (one gate at a time, tools/gate_lock.sh); described in AGENTS.md
tools/ci/verify-pinned-siblings.sh  # run ./check.sh against the sibling revisions CI pins (../abi, ../wdbx untouched)
./tools/cargo.sh test --locked              # default-feature tests only (the whole workspace, client included)
./tools/cargo.sh test --locked -p abbey --features wdbx   # includes src/memory/wdbx.rs
./tools/cargo.sh test --locked -p abbey -p abbey-desktop --features personal-edition   # edition-gated identity/isolation tests
./tools/cargo.sh test --locked <test_name>   # one test by name filter, across the workspace's default members
./tools/cargo.sh test --locked --test cli_surface      # binary-level integration tests only
./tools/cargo.sh test --locked --test cli_surface <test_name>   # one test inside one integration file
./tools/cargo.sh build --locked -p abbey --features accel   # + Metal kernel verification (macOS Xcode toolchain; abi-gpu shells out to xcrun swiftc)
./tools/cargo.sh test --locked -p abbey --features accel
./tools/cargo.sh clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
./tools/cargo.sh clippy --locked -p abbey --features wdbx --all-targets -- -D warnings
./tools/cargo.sh clippy --locked -p abbey -p abbey-desktop --features personal-edition --all-targets -- -D warnings
./tools/cargo.sh clippy --locked -p abbey --features accel --all-targets -- -D warnings
./tools/cargo.sh fmt --package abbey -- --check   # the gate form; NEVER `cargo fmt --all` (it reformats ../abi and ../wdbx)
RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" ./tools/cargo.sh doc --locked --no-deps --document-private-items   # default cohort (whole workspace)
RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" ./tools/cargo.sh doc --locked -p abbey --no-deps --document-private-items --features wdbx
RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" ./tools/cargo.sh doc --locked -p abbey -p abbey-desktop --no-deps --document-private-items --features personal-edition
RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" ./tools/cargo.sh doc --locked -p abbey --no-deps --document-private-items --features accel
python3 tools/check_claims_sync.py           # verify; `--write` regenerates docs/claims.md and the ledger header above
python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p 'test_*.py'   # Python tool tests (also a gate step)
python3 tools/check_instructions.py           # AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md split + every .sh/.py path under ./, tools/, or scripts/ in the command table must exist (gate step)
python3 tools/check_p3_readonly.py           # Program 3 read-only boundary (gate step)
./tools/cargo.sh run --locked -p abbey-desktop-codegen -- --check   # desktop IPC type drift (root gate step)
sh tools/ci/cross-compile-guard.sh           # soft Linux+Windows cross-compile checks; skips uninstalled targets, also runs --features wdbx; never a hard gate
tools/security/run-dep-scan.sh                # cargo-audit (or cargo-deny) advisory scan; CI step; skips only when neither is installed
./desktop/check.sh                           # desktop gate: bun frontend, bundle, desktop tests (the root gate already builds/tests the client); macOS packaged acceptance is opt-in via ABBEY_DESKTOP_PACKAGED_ACCEPTANCE=1
(cd desktop && bun run codegen)              # regenerate desktop IPC types + tauri bundle config after changing src/app_core/ or src/effective_model.rs
ABBEY_COVERAGE=1 ./check.sh                  # opt-in report; needs cargo-llvm-cov
ABBEY_CARGO_FEATURES=personal-edition ./install.sh   # install the separately named personal edition
abbey learn distill [--teacher auto|local|fm|ollama|pcc] [--all] [--file p.txt] <prompt>   # local-first teacher pairs → train_candidate
abbey learn sft                    # export distill pairs as chat-messages JSONL (no weights updated)
abbey learn review [n]             # list train_candidate rows for curation (`abbey memory invalidate <id>` marks one obsolete — it then drops out of `abbey learn sft`)
abbey doctor                       # build stamp + persona/role/memory/os honesty check
abbey claims [current|partial|proposed|blocked|oos|manifest] · abbey claims refuse lora|multinode
abbey daemon status|claims|routes|negotiate|models|run  # authenticated client over the owner-only Unix socket; never falls back to in-process claims
abbey mcp serve [stdio|http|tools]  # Abbey's own read-only MCP server — stdio by default, loopback-only HTTP (`--host`/`--port`)
abbey accel verify                 # Metal kernels against the CPU oracle — only under --features accel
abbey platform compute             # threads/jobs + GPU/NPU/TPU detect (report-only, not an accelerator runtime; host OS/arch is `abbey platform`)
abbey oos [lora|weights|accel|shell|host]   # deferred-capability status + refuse surfaces
abbey runtime                      # tool responsibility matrix (Abbey is not the tool host)
abbey improve status|plan|run [--confirm]  # goal-ledger pick + local subagent lanes + ./check.sh bar; --confirm unlocks apply
abbey subagents run [--lanes ...] [--peers ...] [--synthesize] <prompt...>   # multi-lane fan-out: Abbey persona×role lanes by default, PATH peers with `--peers` (peers bypass the persona/role path)
```

## Module map (`src/`)

| Module | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `main.rs` | pre-Clap SIGPIPE shim delegating to the library; must stay under 200 lines |
| `lib.rs` / `entry.rs` | private implementation graph + library-owned CLI/TUI routing |
| `app_core/` | public protocol-v1 reads, protocol-v2 bounded runs, deny-by-default protocol-v3 contracts, and separately negotiated protocol-v4 conversation contracts (`APP_PROTOCOL_V4 = 4`, `APP_SCHEMA_V4 = 2`; `v4.rs`/`v4_protocol.rs`/`v4_content.rs`/`v4_permission.rs`) that grant no execution authority; `guild_intelligence.rs` (plus `guild_intelligence/plan.rs` and `guild_intelligence/validation.rs`) is Program 3, a read-only planner that `tools/check_p3_readonly.py` keeps free of network/process/fs/store/tool code |
| `run_control.rs` | presentation-neutral protocol-v2 run control shared by CLI and TUI (`tests/run_control*.rs`) |
| `effective_model.rs` | public read-only effective-model contract: the model a turn would use right now, resolved with the shared spawn-path rules so the CLI doctor, the TUI doctor panel, and the desktop client's Doctor panel cannot disagree |
| `abbey_contracts.rs` (+ `abbey_contracts/fixture_validation.rs`) | data-only qualification of the pinned Program 1 Abbey contract corpus under `contracts/abbey/` (`abbey-contracts.lock.json` + `corpus/`; `tests/abbey_contracts.rs`) |
| `daemon/` / `bin/abbeyd.rs` | authenticated bounded Unix v1 reads, v2 run control, v3 safe tool/memory/claim authority, and v4 conversation records (`APP_PROTOCOL_V4 = 4`, `APP_SCHEMA_V4 = 2`) that persist conversations and admit turns without starting a provider, never arbitrary executable/argv/env/workspace; v4 task/automation/permission commands are refused as unserved and the v4 client never retries, downgrades, or replays; `federation.rs` is a separate fail-closed `abbey.v1` envelope that authority-bearing requests never downgrade into |
| `runtime/` | durable run lifecycle (schema v10 in `runtime.sqlite`), opaque conversation identity, bounded process-group supervision, ABI `ModelProvider` adapters, fixed-recipe delegated execution, and legacy-metadata migration; no provider-neutral tool runtime. Schema migrations are the numbered `migration_N_*.sql` files beside `migrations.rs`, each embedded with `include_str!` (all ten); a new migration is a new `.sql` file plus its constant and an entry in `MIGRATIONS`, not inline SQL |
| `accel.rs` (+ `accel/bridge.rs`) | `abbey accel verify` — Metal kernel execution checked against the deterministic CPU oracle, only under `--features accel` |
| `edition.rs` | compile-time safe (default) and separately identified `personal-edition` namespaces; neither edition implements unrestricted execution |
| `mesh.rs` | claim-bounded bridge to ABI's authenticated local multi-process proof on one Unix host, never production multi-host evidence |
| `capture.rs` | backend-aware headless capture shared by print, commit, and voice ask |
| `automation_schedule.rs` (+ `automation_schedule/cron.rs`) | pure schedule math for protocol-v4 automations — Vixie day matching, DST fold/gap resolution, exact chrono-tz zone names; no clock, persistence, or execution authority |
| `cli.rs` | clap `Cli`/`Subcommand` definitions (Grok Build/Codex/Claude Code parity surface) |
| `commands.rs` / `doctor.rs` / `learn.rs` | clap subcommand dispatch (home of the `print` capture bypass); doctor/debug/persona/role/memory/init helpers; self-learning from corrections, routes, and activity into the memory layers |
| `config_snapshot.rs` | read-only view of config plus the live session, with honest per-field provenance; re-exported from `config.rs` (`ConfigSnapshot`/`ConfigSource`/`ConfigField`/`LiveSession`) |
| `actions.rs` | `RunSpec` + `run_agent` — the one path every surface calls |
| `prompts.rs` | review/commit prompt builders over `gitops` diffs |
| `output.rs` | stdout helpers that treat a broken pipe as success (`abbey doctor \| head`) |
| `build_info.rs` | build-stamp constants from `build.rs` (version/git/target/profile/host) |
| `improve/` | `abbey improve`: goal-ledger pick + local subagent lanes + `check.sh` gate; stops on green with no open slice and never auto-closes a goal to done |
| `slash.rs` / `slash_dispatch.rs` / `slash_alias.rs` | slash catalog + shared handler → actions; `slash_alias.rs` maps Claude Code / Codex / Grok slash names onto Abbey catalog names |
| `session.rs` | global flag application, `hybrid_run`, history compaction |
| `persona.rs` / `roles.rs` / `route_log.rs` | hybrid routing spine (`route_decision` → conf/alt/fb on JSONL) |
| `please_fix.rs` | last-failure prompt + capture summarizer (argv-safe) |
| `media.rs` | image/video path attach → `--add-dir` + prompt note (no local vision) |
| `generate.rs` | `imagine` / `generate video` / `reason` via cursor-agent tools (no local models) |
| `voice.rs` / `voice_portable.rs` | macOS Premium/Enhanced TTS + on-device STT (`scripts/abbey-stt.swift`); `voice_portable.rs` holds the portable Whisper/Piper adapters (`ABBEY_WHISPER_MODEL` / `ABBEY_PIPER_MODEL`) used when `say`/Speech.framework are unavailable |
| `protocols.rs` / `protocols/mcp.rs` | MCP config inventory + ACP peer discovery/launch (Abbey is not a *client/host* of other providers' servers) |
| `mcp_host/` | `abbey mcp serve`: Abbey's own read-only MCP server over stdio and loopback-only HTTP with enforced bounds, hostile-Origin/Host rejection, rate limits, and secret redaction; no non-loopback binding, TLS, OAuth, or client-host authority |
| `highlight.rs` | syntect ANSI for fenced code on `-p`/print + `abbey highlight` |
| `subagents.rs` / `subagents/` (`catalog.rs`, `execute.rs`, `parsing.rs`) | multi-subagent lanes + local PATH peer fan-out + synthesize |
| `claims.rs` / `claims/registry.rs` (`claims/registry/types.rs`) | Current/Partial/Proposed/Blocked/OOS gate + refuse paths and machine manifest; `claims/registry/types.rs` holds the typed claim evidence (`Verified`/`Required`/`NotRequired`) so a missing proof cannot be confused with inapplicable proof |
| `platform.rs` | host OS matrix + threads + GPU/NPU/TPU detect (not accelerator runtime) |
| `surfaces.rs` | vision/cot/runtime honesty (neural media/owned host Proposed; hidden CoT OOS) |
| `deferred.rs` | deferred-capability index — lora/weights/accel/host Proposed; shipped-edition shell bypass OOS |
| `argv_budget.rs` | shared 32 KiB argument/64 KiB aggregate limits and UTF-8 prompt truncation; pure helper tests do not qualify native supervision |
| `host.rs` | portable PATH/PATHEXT lookup, argv clamp, install/state path helpers |
| `memory/` | `MemoryStore` trait and backend dispatch (`sqlite.rs` default, `wdbx.rs` behind `--features wdbx`); `similarity.rs` is feature-hash **lexical, not learned** similarity, while learned embeddings are the separate opt-in `embedding.rs`/`semantic.rs` path (API key only via `ABBEY_EMBEDDING_API_KEY`/`OPENAI_API_KEY`) whose provider or model change creates a new isolated vector space and never silently falls back; `map.rs` is a deterministic topic × recency × consolidation map, not an embedding space, and `migrate.rs` moves records between backends with a read-back verification that errors rather than reporting a partial copy as whole |
| `knowledge.rs` / `knowledge/` (`folder.rs`, `live.rs`) | read-only knowledge previews plus separately consented project memory commands; live memory is explicit and never injected into the global agent path |
| `distill.rs` | `abbey learn distill`/`sft`: local-first teachers (fm `system` → ollama → fm `pcc`, off-device last) answer prompts through `capture::capture_oneshot`; answers become provenance-tagged `train_candidate` rows and export as chat-messages JSONL. Data generation only, no weight updates |
| `hybrid_loop.rs` | two-stage Gemma→Max run; stages linked by `correlation` in the route log |
| `ralph.rs` / `ralph/` (`run.rs`, `mcp.rs`, `tests.rs`) | `abbey ralph`: self-learning Rust Ralph loop (fresh-context single-task iterations, `.ralph/` playbook & failure reflections, Cargo gate, and `ralph-loop-rust` stdio MCP server) |
| `wdbx_bridge.rs` | `abbey wdbx` — passthrough to `abi wdbx`, plus in-process `stats`/`checkpoint` |
| `os_control.rs` | cross-platform OS allowlist policy |
| `parallel.rs` | multi-lane fan-out (Max/Gemma/Aviva), now a thin alias over `subagents` |
| `inventory.rs` / `inventory/` (`skills.rs`, `plugins.rs`) | skills/plugins/peer-agent-tool discovery |
| `init/` (`mod.rs`, `detect.rs`, `probe.rs`) | `abbey init` — scans a project and writes `AGENTS.md` |
| `stream/` | executor stdout decoders (`StreamEvent`) for claude, cursor-agent, grok, and plain text, decoded into ordered events and never panicking on bad input |
| `tui/` | chat-first ratatui app: transcript, composer, streaming run worker; `predict.rs` ranks slash completion; `clipboard.rs` copies the last reply via the host's clipboard command |
| `agent/` / `models.rs` / `gitops.rs` / `state.rs` / `state/` / `config.rs` / `cli/args.rs` | executor invocation with an isolated per-backend argv grammar in `agent/argv.rs` (`agent/capture.rs` is the bounded non-Unix capture path, not the top-level `capture.rs`), model aliases, git helpers, canonical-first identity save/clear with a private compatibility-mirror journal, config loading, and leaf clap args; `state/conversation_portable.rs` keeps the exact pre-cutover file behavior on non-Unix hosts and makes no canonicalization claim |
| `learn/` / `owned_cancel_tests.rs` | `learn/args.rs` validates learn arguments before any store or route access; `owned_cancel_tests.rs` holds hermetic owned-execution cancellation regressions (Unix, test-only) |
| `learn_tests.rs` / `voice_portable_tests.rs` | local-only route identity and digest regressions; hermetic Unix voice fixtures (no microphone, model, service, or env changes) |

Work on the default branch in this canonical checkout. Do not create
branches or worktrees by default; they are for tasks that genuinely need
isolation, or when Donald asks. Any worktree or topic branch created here
must be merged back into this checkout's default branch, the worktree
removed, and the branch deleted, before pushing and before the task is
called done. Full policy: `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` (*Git discipline*).
